conventions.evidence: Follows applicable conventions: PasswordResetLinkController.php:156 inline $request->validate(['email']) for one field vs NewPasswordRequest.php:196-199 Form Request for token/email/password; forceFill in NewPasswordController.php:105-108 avoids mass-assignment; {{ }} escaping in both auth views; Bulma-only classes with no JS framework; CHANGELOG.md:26,30 keeps docs in sync

readability.evidence: Clear names (PasswordResetLinkController, NewPasswordController, VerifyEmailController), small focused methods (create/store/__invoke), concise PHPDoc; consistent Breeze-style sibling structure; no dead code or debug output

requirements.evidence: All requirements and contract met: routes/web.php:749-764 password.request/email/reset/update + verification.verify with guest/throttle:6,1/auth+signed; PasswordResetLinkController.php:156-160 validates email and always back()->with('status', __('passwords.sent')); NewPasswordController.php:102-120 Password::reset with remember_token rotation, PasswordReset event, redirect('/'); VerifyEmailController.php:57-64 EmailVerificationRequest 403 + redirect('/'); lang/pt_BR.json:238,246 subjects; config/mail.php:222-227 theme pegafila; pegafila.css:673-680 #0f7490 on .button-primary; edge cases tested (unknown address, invalid token, cross-email token, weak passwords, bad hash, unsigned link)

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task: .env.example, phpunit.xml pins, mail config, theme CSS, lang subjects, 5 routes, 3 controllers + 1 Form Request, 2 auth views, CHANGELOG entry, 3 Pest test files; no login/registration/home/Livewire/layouts/ui.php/docker/scss changes

security.evidence: No weakness found: email/password/token validated server-side (NewPasswordRequest.php:197-199 min 8 + letters + mixedCase + numbers + confirmed); throttle:6,1 on password.email and verification.verify; same passwords.sent response prevents enumeration (PasswordResetLinkController.php:158-160); EmailVerificationRequest 403 on id/hash mismatch; {{ }} escaping; forceFill + remember_token rotation; no secrets in views

simplicity.evidence: Lean and direct: reuses Password facade, EmailVerificationRequest, default ResetPassword/VerifyEmail notifications with no custom notification classes; no service/repository layers or speculative abstractions; theme CSS is required vendor copy with single brand-color change

tests.evidence: Pest tests ship with the change and cover all requirements: tests/Feature/Auth/PasswordResetTest.php 12 tests (form markup, auth redirect, existing/unknown/invalid email, throttle 429, token form single-email assertion, valid reset with Hash check + event + redirect, invalid/cross-email token, confirmation, weak-password dataset); VerifyEmailTest.php 4 tests (happy, bad hash 403, wrong account 403, unsigned 403); AccountEmailsTest.php 5 tests (config pins, theme file, pt-BR subjects/bodies/button/URL/signature, CSS inlining); meaningful assertions, nothing weakened

review.summary: Delivers the full pt-BR password-reset flow and verification link with the pegafila mail theme, correct routes, controllers, views, translations and thorough Pest coverage. No convention, security or scope deviations found, so the change is approved as is.
